response.note: Assumes 'last week' is the previous Monday-Sunday week (2026-10-19 to 2026-10-25) and that declines are attempts with status = 'FAILED'; the exact status value was not given in the schema, so adjust if the failure status label differs.
response.sql: SELECT card_bin, COUNT(*) AS decline_count FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-19' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-26' AND status = 'FAILED' AND card_bin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY card_bin ORDER BY decline_count DESC LIMIT 50
